attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Moves core Liquid filter/service registration (append_version, resource_url, sanitize_html, template manager) from always-on direct DI registration to conditional module-feature activation gated by RequireFeatures/AddGlobalFeatures, which could silently break existing templates/themes that use these filters if the corresponding features aren't enabled in a given tenant or custom host."}

reason: Moves core Liquid filter/service registration (append_version, resource_url, sanitize_html, template manager) from always-on direct DI registration to conditional module-feature activation gated by RequireFeatures/AddGlobalFeatures, which could silently break existing templates/themes that use these filters if the corresponding features aren't enabled in a given tenant or custom host.
